command: flock -n /tmp/owm-cycle.lock env FLOOR_ROOT_M=512 FLOOR_BULK_M=0 $HOME/lanes/bin/disk-floor.sh owm-cycle $HOME/lanes/logs/owm.log nice -n 15 timeout 300 /usr/bin/python3 $HOME/lanes/reaction-orchestrator-20260928/owm.py
note: reaction orchestrator (outer world model). Every 30 min: stage status LIVE/STAGED/MISSING from job evidence, one STALE line per job that missed 2 cycles (dead-man's switch), subject states from own-surface cross-reads and local records. Last log line ends rc=0 (nothing stale) or rc=3 (STALE jobs=...): must_contain rc=0 turns a stale stage red here; max_age 4500s turns a dead orchestrator red. Read-only; writes nothing to canon.
